notes.title: This is Nyu Media, Signing Off!
notes.content:
Guys, we had a GREAT run.

When we started this company in 2011, our primary goals were to support some truly talented Japanese indie developers, to introduce Japanese indie games to overseas gamers, and contribute to the growth of the Japanese indie gaming scene. 11 years later, it's fair to say that, while we made mistakes and fell short at times, we achieved what we set out to do and we can call this a 'WIN'.

The video games industry has changed a lot since we started out, and the tools, resources, and perspective available to Japanese indie devs have broadened and improved to the point where there isn't much need for a company like ours... and that's GREAT!! We hope to see more Japanese indie games making it overseas under their own steam (no crappy pun intended)!

So the time has come for us to close the curtain on Nyu Media, but PLEASE NOTE that all games and related DLC in our catalog will remain for sale on Steam, with the exception of the Cherry Tree High games, which will be delisted from all platforms after the final day of this year's Steam Summer Sale. 

For clarity, here is list of our current titles and what will happen to them from July 1st:

The following titles and related OST, etc. will remain on sale on Steam and publishing responsibilities will transfer as follows:

- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/283840/ALLTYNEX_Second/]ALLTYNEX Second[/url] (SITER SKAIN) > [url=http://www.siterskain.com/]SITER SKAIN[/url] will become the new publisher
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/283820/KAMUI/]KAMUI[/url] (SITER SKAIN) > SITER SKAIN 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/281860/RefleX/]RefleX[/url] (SITER SKAIN) > SITER SKAIN 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/39160/]The Tale of ALLTYNEX[/url] > SITER SKAIN 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/214570/ETHER_VAPOR_Remaster/]ETHER VAPOR Remaster[/url] (Edelweiss) > [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Playism]PLAYISM[/url]
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/207370/eXceed__Gun_Bullet_Children/]eXceed - Gun Bullet Children[/url] (Upgrade) > [url=https://upgrade-corp.com/]Upgrade[/url] 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/207380/eXceed_2nd__Vampire_REX/]eXceed 2nd - Vampire REX[/url] (Upgrade) > Upgrade 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/207400/eXceed_3rd__Jade_Penetrate_Black_Package/]eXceed 3rd - Jade Penetrate Black Package[/url] (Upgrade) > Upgrade 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/15960/]The eXceed Collection[/url] (Upgrade) > Upgrade 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/214590/Fairy_Bloom_Freesia/]Fairy Bloom Freesia[/url] (Edelweiss)> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/xseedgames]XSEED Games[/url]
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/316840/The_Sacred_Tears_TRUE/]The Sacred Tears TRUE[/url] (AlphaNuts) > [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=WhiteCute]WhiteCute[/url]
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/345370/TyranoBuilder_Visual_Novel_Studio/]TyranoBuilder Visual Novel Studio[/url] (STRIKEWORKS) > [url=https://strikeworks.jp/]STRIKEWORKS[/url]
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/319280/Yatagarasu_Attack_on_Cataclysm/]Yatagarasu Attack on Cataclysm[/url] (PDW HOTAPEN) > PDW HOTAPEN / Circle Edge Corp.

Localized versions of the following titles will be DELISTED* from ALL distributors (including Steam) following the Steam summer sale:

- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/214610/Cherry_Tree_High_Comedy_Club/]Cherry Tree High Comedy Club[/url] (773)
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/333220/Cherry_Tree_High_I_My_Girls/]Cherry Tree High I! My! Girls![/url] (773)

* [i]So pick up copies while you can!![/i]

On behalf of the past and present members of the Nyu Media team, [i][b]THANK YOU[/b][/i] to all the AWESOME players, press, partners, and others for your support over the years and for making this possible. Please continue to support these games, devs, and the Japanese indie game scene!

Sincerely,

Seon King
Founder & Managing Director,
Nyu Media Limited

notes.title: Minor Network-related Update
notes.content:
Good morning! 

We just pushed a minor update that allows for specific fine-tuning for networked play. This update does not affect game play or balancing, and won't actually be relevant to most players, but provides another option to optimize networked lay.

The update adds two new items to the Launcher:
- Use Precision FPS Sync
- Frame Tuning (Lower = lighter processing load)

That's it for the moment, but stand by for more updates that are on the way!

notes.title: Yatagarasu Heading to SoCal and CEOtaku
notes.content:
Hey Fans!

Yatagarasu will be holding side tournaments for both the SoCal Regionals and CEOtaku and would love for you to come hang out with us during these two events. 

[h1]Here are the details for the SoCal Regionals:[/h1]
[b]When:[/b] October 9-11th
[b]Where:[/b] Ontario Convention Center, Ontario, California
[b]Official site:[/b] http://www.socalregionals.com/
[b]Official Yatagarasu announcement:[/b] https://www.facebook.com/events/1531984730397880/permalink/1549180635344956/

[h1]Here are the details for CEOtaku:[/h1]
[b]When:[/b] October 17-18th
[b]Where:[/b] Orlando, Florida
[b]Official site:[/b] http://ceogaming.org/ceotaku/

Check out our twitter post about it and make sure to retweet as well as visit the blog for full details:
